title: Restore default-feature lichen-link test compilation
description: cargo test --locked -p lichen-link fails to compile rust/lichen-link/tests/root_authorization_vectors.rs because it unconditionally imports keys::PublicKey and schnorr while both exports are gated behind the schnorr feature and the crate default feature set is empty. Gate the integration test or declare the appropriate required feature/test configuration so the crate's default test command compiles and runs.
close_reason: Verified fixed at HEAD: tests/root_authorization_vectors.rs:2 has #![cfg(feature = "schnorr")] AND Cargo.toml:33-35 has [[test]] required-features = ["schnorr"]. cargo test --locked -p lichen-link (default features) now compiles all targets: 16/16 'test result: ok' + doc-tests 1 passed (DOC_EXIT=0), zero failures. No changes needed.
